remarks: Welcome to Chesterfield, one of Stamford's most sought-after gated communities! This freshly painted 1-bedroom, 1-bath unit offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and style! The open-concept living and dining area with hardwood floors, is bright and inviting, featuring sliding glass doors that lead to a private deck, ideal for outdoor dining or morning coffee! The newer kitchen is well-appointed with ample cabinetry, granite counters and a center island, making meal prep a breeze! The spacious bedroom has hardwood floors and offers generous closet storage. This unit also has a laundry room with additional storage, as well as access to a crawl space. Residents of Chesterfield enjoy access to outstanding community amenities, including a 24-hour gated entrance, two swimming pools, and beautifully landscaped grounds. The location is terrific, just minutes from vibrant downtown Stamford, shopping, dining, Metro-North, and major highways. A wonderful place to call home! Some photos are virtually staged.
